title: Comparing the Quality of Code Generated by Vibe Coding Tools
abstract: arXiv:2608.16302v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The use of AI agents for automatic code generation has become increasingly common in software development. However, concerns remain about the quality of the generated code, including aspects of maintainability, readability, and long-term evolution. This study compares the structural quality of code produced by three widely adopted vibe coding tools --- Lovable, v0, and Replit --- starting from a single generation prompt. We generate three independent projects per tool, totalling nine web applications, and submit them to static analysis with SonarQube. We collect metrics such as the number of issues, severity distribution, estimated remediation effort, cyclomatic and cognitive complexity, and code duplication. Preliminary results show that the tools exhibit distinct qualitative profiles: Lovable concentrates issues of lower severity but presents a substantially higher density of code smells per KLOC, while v0 and Replit produce more code

translated_title: 比较Vibe编码工具生成代码的质量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16302v1 公告类型：新 摘要：使用AI代理自动生成代码在软件开发中已变得越来越普遍。然而，对生成代码质量的担忧仍然存在，包括可维护性、可读性和长期演进等方面。本研究比较了三种广泛采用的Vibe编码工具——Lovable、v0和Replit——从单一生成提示开始生成的代码结构质量。我们为每个工具生成三个独立项目，共九个Web应用，并提交给SonarQube进行静态分析。我们收集了问题数量、严重性分布、估计修复工作量、圈复杂度和认知复杂度以及代码重复等指标。初步结果显示，这些工具表现出不同的质量特征：Lovable集中了较低严重性的问题，但每千行代码的代码异味密度显著更高，而v0和Replit则产生更多代码。
tldr: 本研究通过静态分析比较了三种Vibe编码工具生成代码的结构质量，发现各工具在问题严重性和代码异味密度上存在明显差异。
en_tdlr: This study compares the structural quality of code generated by three Vibe coding tools via static analysis, revealing distinct profiles in issue severity and code smell density.
